name: FUFIRI (Douillard weekly)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
source.nccnTemplate: pending - per-disease NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template not yet provided

institution.provenance: textbook-grounded draft; NCCN per-disease template + clinical (StewardMD) + hospital/institutional approval pending

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: per moderate emetic risk tier (see supportiveCare); given before irinotecan on each weekly day

supportiveCare: antiemetics: moderate emetic risk tier per NCCN Appendix D (irinotecan is the highest-risk component of this regimen; 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin are low/minimal emetic risk) - 5-HT3 antagonist +/- dexamethasone on treatment days

G-CSF: FUFIRI/irinotecan-fluoropyrimidine weekly regimens are not itemized by name in NCCN Appendix C (Appendix C gives only High/Intermediate/Low risk-level definitions, not a per-regimen table); treat as low-to-intermediate febrile neutropenia risk and apply the Appendix C risk-benefit discussion (patient risk factors, prior FN) rather than routine primary prophylactic G-CSF - physician judgment, verify against the NCCN Myeloid Growth Factors guideline
monitoring: renal function (5-FU/irinotecan dosing depends on organ function per source footnote: doses are starting doses for good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function)
diarrhea/GI toxicity assessment before each weekly dose (irinotecan)

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1000 or platelets < 100k on day of treatment
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: Irinotecan
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123603: Irinotecan 80 mg/m2, then LV 500 mg/m2, followed by 5-FU 2,300 mg/m2; all drugs given weekly for 6 wk, repeated every 7 wk (Douillard et al., 2000). Not on NCCN Appendix G tall-man list.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123603: LV 500 mg/m2, given weekly for 6 wk, repeated every 7 wk. Given concurrently with/after irinotecan, before 5-FU. Not on NCCN Appendix G tall-man list (list has LEVOleucovorin, a different agent, not plain leucovorin).

drugs.name: Fluorouracil
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed., line 123603: 5-FU 2,300 mg/m2, given weekly for 6 wk, repeated every 7 wk. Source footnote 317: doses are recommended starting doses for good performance status patients with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function; individual dose adjustments may be required. Not on NCCN Appendix G tall-man list.
